sb.senses: Blindsight 120 ft., Darkvision 240 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Defeat from Victory
traits.desc: When Nyarlathotep drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, he is not slain. Instead, his body ripples with energy as it undergoes a horrific transformation. He returns to whatever strange realm he dwells in as his defeated form is torn apart by unseen forces. Mythos creatures with a combined CR of up to 20 emerge from the pile of gore, occupying the nearest, empty space. These creatures attack those who were hostile to Nyarlathotep and fight to the death.

actions.name: Shape-Shift

actions.name: Spellcasting

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Monster|Charm Monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|Misty Step]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|Pass without Trace]]

sb.name: Shub-Niggurath
sb.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

traits.name: Boundless Horror
traits.desc: When Shub-Niggurath drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a swarm of insects that fill its space. At the start of each of Shub-Niggurath's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum Hit Points return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost Hit Points. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points. If Shub-Niggurath's space is filled with magical fire it is banished from the world and prevented from returning for 4d10 years.

traits.name: Horrid Garden
traits.desc:
Horrid vines, slick acidic dew and covering in flesh, gnawing mouths erupt from the ground in a 120-foot Emanation originating from Shub-Niggurath. The effect of this trait depends on its level. When Shub-Niggurath rolls initiative, set this trait's level to 0. The trait's level increase by 1 after each of Shub-Niggurath's turns to a maximum of 3. Use the highest AC bonus granted by this trait. Shub-Niggurath gains the benefits of this trait's current level and all lower ones. These benefits end when Shub-Niggurath is no longer threatened by hostile creatures.

- **Level 0.** No effect.
- **Level 1.** The ground in the Emanation is Difficult Terrain for non-Plants. At the end of Shub-Niggurath's turns, including the turn in which this trait reached level 1, two awakened trees appear in open spots in the Emanation of Shub-Niggurath's choice. They immediately roll initiative and aid their Dark Mother.
- **Level 2.** A non-plant takes 15 Acid damage, or 30 Acid damage if it has the Prone condition, when it ends its turn in the Emanation.
- **Level 3.** Plants have Advantage on all attack rolls made against non-Plants in the Emanation. A creature hit by a Plant's melee attack gains the Prone condition.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If Shub-Niggurath fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Shub-Niggurath makes four total Grasping Tendril and Stomping Hoff attacks.

actions.name: Grasping Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +17, Reach 30 ft. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and the target is moved to the open space closest to Shub-Niggurath.

actions.name: Stomping Hoof
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +17, Reach 10 ft. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and the target gains the Prone condition.

actions.name: The Earth Hungers (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 25, creatures of Shub-Niggurath's choice within 200 ft. of Shub-Niggurath and the ground. Failure: The target takes 110 (20d10) Bludgeoning damage, is pulled to the ground beneath it if it is flying, and gains the Prone and Restrained conditions as fibrous plant tendrils erupt from the ground. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. Success: Half damage, and the target is pulled to the ground beneath it if it is flying.

bonus_actions.name: Tree Walk
bonus_actions.desc: Shub-Niggurath may teleport to any open space, provided she ends that teleportation within 10 feet of a friendly Plant creature she can see.

legendary_actions.desc: Shub-Niggurath makes a Grasping Tendril Attack

legendary_actions.name: Rapid Maneuver
